topic: Voyager 1 is now one light-day from Earth
angle: A message you send today arrives tomorrow: what one light-day of distance really means
why_now: NASA confirmed Voyager 1 crossed one light-day (25.9 billion km) on 18 Nov 2026; searches for 'Voyager 1 light day' spiked in US, GB and IN this week.
audience: Curious 16–35 year olds who know Voyager by name but not the scale
hook_options: If you said hello to Voyager 1 right now, it would hear you tomorrow.
The most distant thing humans ever built just crossed a line nobody can see.
title_options: Voyager 1 Is Now One Light-Day Away
Say Hello Today, Voyager Hears It Tomorrow
must_include: a signal takes 24 hours each way
avoid: claims that Voyager has left the solar system's gravitational influence
visual_direction: 3D world built in code: Earth shrinking to a pale dot as a light pulse travels outward; real NASA launch film and the Pale Blue Dot image as evidence.
give_time_to: the light pulse arriving a full day later

competitors.title: Voyager 1 Is Leaving Us
competitors.takeaway: Strong awe hook, but no sense of scale

learnings.statement: Space scale videos hold viewers when the first 2 s show motion toward the viewer

dimensions.what: The first 1–2 seconds stop the scroll

engine_request_md:
Make a 45-second short about Voyager 1 reaching one light-day from Earth.

Angle: a message you send today arrives tomorrow.
Audience: curious 16–35 year olds.
Platform: YouTube Shorts
Tone: awe, curious

Visuals: animation built in code with three.js; real NASA launch film and the Pale Blue Dot only as evidence.
Give time to: the light pulse arriving a day later; the Pale Blue Dot.
Music: slow, vast, building

Must include: 25.9 billion km; 24 hours each way; launched 1977
Avoid: claims that Voyager left the Sun's gravitational influence
